name: Re-Stage Cumulative allowed_files at execution_complete
goal: Make the end-of-loop commit capture the full intended file set even if a subagent's git stash pop dropped earlier tasks out of the index, by re-staging the union of every task's allowed_files at execution_complete in the executing-plans skill.

tasks.name: Re-stage step in executing-plans Step 7 + governance test
tasks.description: Add a re-stage step to executing-plans SKILL.md Step 7 (before the commit-message suggestion) that re-stages the deduped union of every task's allowed_files from the plan JSON (existing paths only, git add -- explicit paths, orchestrator-run after subagents). Add a governance test in commander/tests/test_executing_plans_skill.py asserting the step exists before the commit-message suggestion and references git stash pop + union. TDD: write the test (RED), edit the skill (GREEN), full regression (no build).

steps.description: Add imports (json, re, subprocess) then append TWO governance tests to test_executing_plans_skill.py (module-level _read()): (1) test_execution_complete_restages_cumulative_allowed_files — assert 'Re-stage the cumulative allowed_files' in text, index Step 7, assert the re-stage precedes 'Suggest a commit message', assert 'git stash pop' and 'union' present; (2) test_execution_complete_restage_command_stages_from_non_root_cwd(tmp_path) — extract the Step 7 bash command via regex, fill <plan-json-path>/<repo-root>, run it from cwd=repo/commander in a temp git repo, assert returncode 0, a missing allowed_file tolerated, only worker/a.md staged and worker/outside.md left unstaged. Both RED pre-edit (text-presence fails first assert; behavioral errors on text.index ValueError).
steps.expected: FAIL: the new test fails at the first assert (SKILL.md lacks 'Re-stage the cumulative allowed_files').

steps.description: In SKILL.md Step 7, insert item 2 'Re-stage the cumulative allowed_files' (guards a subagent git stash pop; re-stage the deduped union of every task's allowed_files from the plan JSON via a python3 one-liner using t.get('allowed_files', []) piped into `while read f; if [ -e "<repo-root>/$f" ]; then git -C <repo-root> add -- "$f"; fi` — the existence test is repo-root-anchored so it works from cwd=commander/, and if..fi not && so a missing last path keeps exit 0) BEFORE the 'Suggest a commit message' item, renumbering it to 3. Full text in the human plan.
steps.expected: Step 7 has the re-stage step before the commit-message suggestion

steps.description: Run the skill test file to confirm GREEN.
steps.expected: all tests in the file pass (prior + new).
